author: Tikai
body:
My IGN name is : iiiAlpha

I was banned for 'Kill Aura'

I was playing a nexus style point game with kits, I was a 'Scout'.
I was falsely accused of hacking while I was playing and even had to report 1 of them for spam.
Why should I be banned for a glitch in a game on your server? That is the fast hitting glitch.
The Scouts speed gave me a little extra reach as it usually does.
And i'd like to raise the fact that I reported someone for spam and 'GrapeSmoothie' didn't mute him. He deemed falsely banning me more important.
I have quite a few friends on that server that know I don't hack. I was even in a Team.
This is one of my favourite servers and I would REALLY not want to be banned for 'hacking'.

Thank you for your consideration :)

iiiAlpha

GrapeSmoothie, Senior Moderator
